shared p_schoolowners_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schoolowners_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;

  #"Added custom 2" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced value 1", "DateUpdated", each DateTime.Date(DateTime.LocalNow())), {{"DateUpdated", type date}}),
  #"Replaced value 2" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added custom 2", "NULL", "3", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"gender"}),
  #"Duplicated column" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Replaced value 2", "address", "address - Copy"),
  #"Replaced value 3" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Duplicated column", "\\x00", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"address - Copy"})

,
  #"Added custom 3" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced value 3", "FullName", each [first_name] & " " & [last_name]), {{"FullName", type text}}),
  #"Replaced value 4" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added custom 3", ":", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"address"}),
  #"Replaced value 5" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 4", """", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"address"}),
  #"Changed column type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Replaced value 5", {{"gender", Int64.Type}})


in
